pending: Canonical WFA config fields and expected output root must fail before worker launch/evidence acceptance.
criteria.rationale: Prevents stale or wrong-root WFA outputs from becoming evidence.

pending: WFE/WFR must compute only from accepted metrics artifacts and otherwise report blocked inputs.
criteria.rationale: Needed for Phase 8D evidence quality; no invented robustness metrics.

pending: Purge-gap support and diagnostic-only warmup handling must be explicit.
criteria.rationale: Reduces leakage risk while avoiding fake generic indicator-warmup protection.

pending: Disconnected optimizer/cost modules must not imply active evidence.
criteria.rationale: Current Phase 8D safety need is truthful fail-loud reporting, not wiring unused modules.

pending: Positive WFA labels must fail below 8 windows, 200 trades unless valid low-frequency registration, 5% return proxy, and 70% positive windows.
criteria.rationale: This is the core gate that prevents weak Phase 8D screening results from being labeled survivors.

pending: Explicit Phase 8D/screening WFA intent must require hash-backed pre-run research-WFA pre-registration before launch.
criteria.rationale: Required to prevent WFA roulette before candidate screening.

pending: DSR/PBO/CPCV/White must report or block exact inputs but remain non-authoritative.
criteria.rationale: Avoids false confidence from advisory stats while preserving diagnostics for serious candidates.

pending: Source-quality-blocked Stage-0 packets must not reach direct WFA routes through hidden config/command metadata.
criteria.rationale: Prevents ResearchBrain packet/source laundering into executable WFA evidence.

pending: Repeated artifact-backed failures may create bounded remediation items without recursive/generic spam.
criteria.rationale: Supports learning from failures without turning Phase 8C into endless backlog generation.

pending: Role prompts/spec must state survivor floors are validation gates, not optimization targets.
criteria.rationale: Prevents agents from tuning toward floor thresholds after seeing results.

pending: Physical deletion/quarantine or full wiring of disconnected optimizer/cost modules is deferred unless evidence shows current fail-loud truth diagnostics can be bypassed.
criteria.rationale: Not required for Phase 8D safety now because current accepted WFA evidence records the active direct-Optuna path and flags disconnected modules as inactive.

pending: Strategy-specific indicator warmup inference is deferred; Phase 8C only requires explicit purge-gap behavior and fail-loud diagnostic-only warmup truth.
criteria.rationale: Generic inference would be speculative and could create false leakage confidence.

pending: Hard DSR/PBO/CPCV/White promotion gates and deterministic statistical input producers remain separate future work.
criteria.rationale: Phase 8D can screen with advisory/reporting stats; making them hard gates now would overstate their authority.

pending: Wiring cost-stress, transaction-cost modeler, or multi-objective optimizer into accepted WFA metrics is deferred until a concrete candidate/evidence need exists.
criteria.rationale: Reporting-only provenance is enough to prevent false claims before Phase 8D screening.

closure_assessment: Phase 8C can close as WFA/evidence-safety hardening. Remaining deferred items are optional or later-phase work, not Phase 8D safety blockers.
